items.name: theme
items.title: seam native theme tokens
items.description: Platform-neutral design tokens for React Native: colors (precomputed from the canonical oklch), radii (px), and depth shadows as boxShadow strings, with light and dark sets.

items.name: motion
items.title: seam native motion tokens
items.description: Spring presets and the depth (z-axis) scale that power every seamui native animation, on react-native-reanimated. Personality numbers are identical to the web tokens.

items.name: haptics
items.title: seam native haptics
items.description: Haptic feedback layer for React Native: HapticsProvider and the useHaptics hook every interactive control fires through, powered by expo-haptics. Same contract as the web haptics lib.
